sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Bitwise: Instruction Execution Flow

nodes.label: Bitwise Opcode Fetched

nodes.label: Pop Operands from Stack
nodes.description: Pop 1 or 2 operands from EVM stack depending on operation

nodes.label: Charge GAS_VERY_LOW
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_VERY_LOW (3 gas) for bitwise operation

nodes.label: Execute Bitwise Operation
nodes.description: Perform the bitwise computation (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, etc.)

nodes.description: Push computation result onto EVM stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance PC by 1 to next instruction

nodes.label: Bitwise Operation Complete
nodes.description: Operation finished, ready for next instruction

nodes.label: Stack Underflow Error

nodes.label: Compute Bitwise AND

nodes.label: OR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Two U256 values popped for OR operation

nodes.label: Compute Bitwise OR
nodes.description: Calculate x | y, result is U256

nodes.label: XOR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Two U256 values popped for XOR operation

nodes.label: Compute Bitwise XOR
nodes.description: Calculate x ^ y, result is U256

nodes.description: Single U256 value popped for NOT operation

sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Bitwise: Shift Operations (SHL, SHR, SAR)
sub_graphs.description: Models shift operations with edge case handling for large shifts

nodes.label: SHL Operands Ready
nodes.description: Shift amount and value popped for left shift

nodes.label: Check SHL Overflow
nodes.description: Check if shift >= 256 (would overflow)

nodes.label: Compute Left Shift
nodes.description: Calculate (value << shift) & MAX_VALUE

nodes.label: SHR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Shift amount and value popped for logical right shift

nodes.label: Check SHR Overflow
nodes.description: Check if shift >= 256 (would underflow to zero)

nodes.label: Compute Logical Right Shift
nodes.description: Calculate value >> shift (zero-fill)

nodes.label: SAR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Shift amount and value popped for arithmetic right shift

nodes.label: Convert to Signed Integer
nodes.description: Interpret U256 as signed 256-bit integer

nodes.label: Compute Arithmetic Right Shift
nodes.description: Shift signed value preserving sign bit

nodes.label: Shift Result is Zero
nodes.description: Large shift resulted in zero (SHL/SHR) or MAX for negative SAR

nodes.label: Shift Result Computed
nodes.description: Normal shift operation completed

sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Bitwise: BYTE Operation
sub_graphs.description: Models the BYTE opcode for extracting individual bytes from a word

nodes.label: BYTE Operands Ready
nodes.description: Byte index and value popped from stack

nodes.label: Check Byte Index Bounds
nodes.description: Verify byte_index < 32 (valid byte position)

nodes.label: Extract Target Byte
nodes.description: Right-shift to position and mask with 0xFF

nodes.label: BYTE Result is Zero
nodes.description: Index >= 32, return zero

nodes.label: Byte Extracted
nodes.description: Single byte extracted and zero-extended to U256

ambiguities.text: BYTE opcode indexes bytes 'left-to-right (most to least significant)' which is opposite to typical little-endian conventions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume big-endian byte ordering: index 0 is the most significant byte (leftmost in 256-bit word)

ambiguities.text: SAR behavior for shift >= 256 with negative values states 'returns MAX_VALUE' but doesn't specify if this is signed or unsigned MAX
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume returns U256.MAX_VALUE (all 1s) as the sign-extended result of shifting a negative number

implicit_assumptions.description: All bitwise operations operate on 256-bit unsigned integers (U256)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different integer widths could cause truncation or overflow in unexpected ways

implicit_assumptions.description: GAS_VERY_LOW constant is 3 gas for all bitwise operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different gas costs could affect contract economic assumptions

implicit_assumptions.description: Stack underflow is detected before gas is charged
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas could be incorrectly deducted for operations that fail due to stack underflow

implicit_assumptions.description: Attacker cannot exploit timing differences between different shift amounts
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timing side channels could leak information about operand values
